app_store.name: StrataMaster: Audio Mastering
app_store.subtitle: Studio True-Peak & LUFS Rack
app_store.promotional_text: Professional C++20 mastering suite: 8-band dynamic EQ, 4-band dynamics, oversampled saturation, stereo imager, lookahead true-peak limiter, and EBU R128 loudness metering.
app_store.description:
StrataMaster is a professional audio mastering suite and standalone audio processor built with modern C++20.

Deliver broadcast-ready masters with pristine acoustic transparency, ultra-low CPU overhead, and zero bloat.

What you get:
- 8-band parametric & dynamic equalizer with sidechain modulation
- 4-band phase-compensated Linkwitz-Riley crossover flat to 0.003 dB
- Multiband dynamics processor with downward compression and auto-makeup
- Harmonic exciter with 4x/8x oversampled Tape, Tube, and Warm saturation
- Microdynamics transient and sustain envelope shaper
- Stereo imager with Haas stereoizer and 100% mono cancellation guarantee
- Lookahead true-peak limiter with 4x polyphase inter-sample detection
- ITU-R BS.1770-4 & EBU R128 loudness metering (Integrated, Short-Term, Momentary LUFS, and LRA)
- 4096-point real-time FFT spectrum analyzer with octave smoothing
- Level-matched reference track player with click-free A/B crossfading
- Intelligent mastering assistant with streaming, club, pop, and acoustic targets

Runs smoothly on your system with under 3% CPU usage and zero background daemons.
